Definition: from G1537 and G5055; to complete fully:--finish.
BiblicalUsage: ekteléō is a plain word for finish. In Luke 14:29, the text says "and is not able to finish [it."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, ekteléō, does its job quietly — finish — and I leave it at that.
